title: 第5章 一线希望
content_zh:
君邪这句话的音量虽然低，但听在君无意耳朵里却无异是晴空惊雷！

蓦然间，君无意双目大张，浑身突然出现了一层混蒙蒙的黄光，堂堂皇皇，令人不敢逼视，身上透露出一股异常强大的气势，一把抓住了君邪的胳膊，急切的道：“莫邪，难道你有办法治好我？”

看来，君无意养伤的这些年，也从未停止过玄气心法的修炼，这层黄光已经表明了，他已经是地玄高手的修为。虽然还只是初阶，但以他的年龄而论，却已经是非常的难能可贵！

整个天香城里，一共才几位地玄高手？！君无意能在三旬之龄就冲到地级境界，已经可说是天纵奇才！更别说他的下半shen经络有严重缺陷，若是缺陷不在，他的实力势必将进入另一个更高深的层次！

君邪胳臂咔咔作响，几乎被君无意强大的力量抓裂，脸上神色却是一片淡然，似乎那不是自己的皮肉，一点也感觉不到疼痛一般，微笑道：“希望不大，但却可以试一试。”

君无意突然醒悟过来，连忙松开了手，看着自己的手，脸上却突然泛起一股疑惑之色，看着君邪：“你不痛？为什么不叫？”

“痛！”君邪淡然道：“叫出来就能不痛吗？若是能不痛，我肯定会大声的叫出来，可惜，不能！”

看到君邪脸上的淡然，君无意大大一怔，深深的看了他一眼，突然爽朗的大笑：“哈哈，我现在居然有点相信，你有本事能治好我了。”

这个侄儿，似乎和从前不一样了！君无意暗暗的对自己说。

“眼下要做的是，每天早中晚各一次，让下人给你按摩全身，最好是有武功底子的下人，顺着经脉按摩，不放过任何一处；然后每天晚上，用滚烫的水浸泡一个时辰，不能有间断，过一段时间，在这段时间里我准备一下，就可以开始为你治疗了，如何？”君邪笑了笑。

君无意情绪慢慢平息下来，重重的道：“好！莫邪，三叔我信你一次！”双手慢慢的握成了拳头，君无意慢慢的道：“纵然不成，我也认了。”有一句话没有说出来：纵然你是在耍我，我也认了。

“这些年来，难道三叔你就没有求过医嘛？”君邪有些奇怪，在为君无意检查了一遍之后，发现君无意的情况，还真是不容乐观。整个腰部经脉已经完全被封锁，而且，似乎还有一种邪恶的药物在慢慢的侵蚀体内的经脉，若不是保养得好，恐怕此刻早已经肌肉彻底萎缩了，那可就彻底的废了，再没有恢复的可能了！可是，对于这种病症，若是有高明的医生，就算无法对症下药，看得出来也是应该可以才是的。

“何止！帝国所有知名的郎中，几乎都来看过。我这是被人用阴毒手法封住了经脉，更被暗中下了一种非常诡异的无名剧毒，让我生不得，死不得……”君无意恨恨的道：“父亲曾经几度尝试，可是始终无法解开那阴毒的封脉手法，至于那种无名剧毒更无药可救，唯一的能做的也只是用至强的玄气将它逼出来，这或者是唯一一种可以治愈我的方法。”

“那为何？…….”君邪问了一半，又住了嘴。

“当年暗算我的人，十年前便已经是天品高手了，要想解开他的封印，更逼出剧毒，非得至尊神品的高手全力出手不可！而至尊神品的高手本就是神话般无敌的存在，平常便神龙见首而不见尾，难得一见。更何况治疗我的伤势之后，受剧毒所致，这位为我治疗的至尊神品高手便会丧失一半的实力，而且永远不能恢复！”

君无意惨笑起来：“有哪一位至尊神品高手会为了我做出这么大的牺牲？莫邪，修炼到至尊神品如同登天的难度！有谁会为了别人将自己的修为生生砍去一半？”

“真够狠的！让你明知道有救治的希望，但却又等于没希望……”君邪摇了摇头，啧啧叹道：“看来这人恨你还不是一般的恨！用这等阴损的方法来折磨你！他的目的只怕就是要让你求生无门，求死不甘！”顿了一顿，突出不意的问道：“那人是我君家的世仇吗？”

“莫邪，你……从何处得知的治疗我的方法？”对君邪的问题，君无意目中掠过一抹痛色，刻意的回避不提，只是看着君邪，上下打量：“今天的你，怎地好像是变了一个人！”

“三叔的病，其实日夜都记挂在我心头，”君邪汗了一下，道：“我也是无意之中得知一种偏方，而且很有效。就想试一试；三叔，千万别说那些外道的话，说实话，我希望三叔早一些好起来，也是为我自己打算，我可是希望在三叔的庇佑之下，安安稳稳的做一个二世祖呀，我这人，就是这么的实在！哈哈。”

“臭小子！”君无意笑骂了一句，突然神色郑重，道：“莫邪，无论成与不成，三叔都承你的情！”这句话说的，掷地有声。

“三叔，你就等着给我遮风挡雨让我做二世祖吧，哈哈……”君邪检查了一遍，心中大定；只要自己前世的内力能练回来一点，再配以自己独门的针灸之术，找齐另外两份药材配药，三管齐下，治疗君无意的伤势完全不在话下。

之所以让君无意先用那几种方法慢慢恢复，大部分都只是君邪的托词罢了。因为到现在，他还半点内力修为也没有！而金针刺穴，却是需要精湛内力修为支撑的。

君无意眼睛一亮，听出了他话中强大的自信之意，微笑道：“莫邪，你只有区区三品玄气修为，就算比之普通人也强不了哪里去，但却经受住了我的一抓之力！甚至脸上毫不变色，这样的忍耐力，可不是一般的二世祖呀。”

刚才那一抓，无意之中虽然没有使出全力，但地玄高手的一抓岂是常人所能够忍受的？恐怕就算是金玄高手，只怕也要为之皱眉，但君邪这个明显只有三品玄气的不入流的人物竟然承受了下来，甚至完全没有动用本身的低微玄气抵抗！

这其中要承受多大的痛苦君无意心知肚明，而且是毫无防备的情况下承受这一抓，脸上却不变色！这份心性……

可惜了！看着君邪，君无意心中长叹一声，可惜君邪此时的年龄已经偏大了，就算再能吃苦，今生修习高端玄气也是无望了，要不然，以他这份坚忍来看，只怕君家还真有可能出现一个强大的高手！

我们还差三名就上首页的新书榜了，风凌要求不高，就希望今天能够让邪君站在新书榜上！希望兄弟们抬抬手帮帮忙，投上一票，让我们的邪君再踏上一步。拜托兄弟们了！众人拾柴火焰高，哪怕是一票，风凌也足感盛情！拜托了.......谢谢>

content_en:
Although the volume of Jun Xie's words was low, to Jun Xie's ears it was like thunder in the clear sky!

Suddenly, Jun Xie's eyes widened, and a layer of hazy yellow light suddenly appeared all over his body. It was so majestic that no one dared to look at it. He revealed an unusually powerful aura. He grabbed Jun Xie's arm and said eagerly: "Mo Xie, do you have a way to cure me?"

It seems that Jun Wuyi has never stopped practicing the Xuan Qi mind method during these years of recuperation. This layer of yellow light has shown that he is already a master of the Earth Xuan.Although he is still at the beginning, considering his age, he is already very valuable!

There are only a few Earth Mysterious masters in the entire Tianxiang City?!Jun Wuyi was able to reach the earth-level realm at the age of thirty, and he was already a genius!Not to mention that his lower body meridians have serious defects. If the defects were not there, his strength would surely enter another higher level!

Jun Xie's arm made a crackling sound and was almost scratched by Jun Yiyi's powerful force. However, the expression on his face was indifferent, as if it was not his own skin and flesh, and he did not feel any pain at all. He smiled and said: "The hope is not high, but you can give it a try."

Jun Wuyi suddenly woke up and quickly let go of his hand. He looked at his hand, but a look of confusion suddenly appeared on his face. He looked at Jun Xie: "You don't feel pain? Why don't you scream?"

"It hurts!" Jun Xie said calmly: "Can it stop the pain if I scream? If it can stop the pain, I will definitely scream out loud, but unfortunately, I can't!"

Seeing the indifference on Jun Xie's face, Jun Yiyi was startled, looked at him deeply, and suddenly laughed heartily: "Haha, I actually believe now that you have the ability to cure me."

This nephew seems to be different from before!Jun Wuyi said to himself secretly.

"What you need to do now is to have a servant massage your whole body once in the morning, noon and evening every day. It is best to have a servant with martial arts background. Massage along the meridians without missing any part. Then every night, soak in boiling water for an hour without interruption. After a while, I will prepare during this time and then I can start treating you. How about it?" Jun Xie smiled.

Jun Yiyi's emotions slowly calmed down and he said solemnly: "Okay! Mo Xie, third uncle, I believe you once!" His hands slowly clenched into fists, and Jun Yiyi said slowly: "Even if it doesn't work, I admit it." There was one sentence that was not said: Even if you are playing tricks on me, I admit it.

"Third uncle, haven't you ever sought medical treatment in these years?" Jun Xie was a little surprised. After checking Jun Wuyi, he found that Jun Wuyi's condition was really not optimistic.The entire waist meridians have been completely blocked, and there seems to be an evil drug that is slowly eroding the meridians in the body. If it had not been well maintained, I am afraid that the muscles would have completely atrophied by now, and it would be completely useless, with no possibility of recovery!However, for this kind of disease, if there is a skilled doctor, even if the right medicine cannot be prescribed, it should be possible to see it.

"More than that! Almost all the well-known doctors in the empire have come to see me. My meridians were sealed with sinister techniques, and a very strange and unknown poison was secretly administered to me, making me unable to live or die..." Jun Wuyi said bitterly: "FatherI have tried several times, but I have never been able to unlock the sinister pulse-sealing technique. As for the nameless poison, there is no cure. The only thing I can do is to use the most powerful profound energy to force it out.This may be the only way to cure me."

"Then why?..." Jun Xie paused halfway through asking.

"The person who plotted against me was already a heavenly master ten years ago. If we want to break his seal and force out the poison, the supreme divine master must take full action! And the supreme divine master is a mythical and invincible existence, and it is rare to see him as a dragon. What's more, after treating my injury, due to the poison, the supreme divine master who treated me will lose half of his strength and will never recover!"

Jun Wuyi laughed miserably: "Which supreme master would make such a big sacrifice for me? Mo Xie, cultivating to the supreme master is as difficult as ascending to the sky! Who would cut off half of his cultivation for others?"

"How cruel! You know that there is hope for treatment, but there is no hope..." Jun Xie shook his head and sighed: "It seems that this person hates you more than ordinary hatred! He uses such despicable methods to torture you! His purpose is probably to make you unable to survive and unwilling to die!" After a pause, he asked unexpectedly: "Is that person the feud of my Jun family?"

"Mo Xie, where did you... know how to treat me?" Regarding Jun Xie's question, a flash of pain flashed across Jun Xie's eyes, and he deliberately avoided mentioning it. He just looked at Jun Xie and looked him up and down: "You seem to be a different person today!"

"Third uncle's illness is actually on my mind day and night," Jun Xie sweated and said, "I also accidentally learned about a folk remedy, and it is very effective. I just want to give it a try; Third uncle, please don't say those heretical things. To be honest, I hope that third uncle will get better soon, and it is also for my own sake. I hope that under the protection of third uncle, I can be a second-generation ancestor safely. I am such a real person! Haha."

"You brat!" Jun Wuyi cursed with a smile, then suddenly looked solemn and said: "Mo Xie, no matter whether you succeed or not, my third uncle will always accept your love!" This sentence was very resounding.

"Third uncle, just wait and shelter me from the wind and rain and let me be the second generation ancestor, haha..." Jun Xie checked it over and was determined; as long as he can regain some of his internal strength from his previous life, coupled with his own acupuncture technique, and find two other medicinal materials to prepare the medicine, it will be a three-pronged approach to treat Jun Wuyi's injuries.

The reason why Jun Yiyi was allowed to use those methods to recover slowly was mostly just Jun Xie's excuse.Because until now, he still has no internal strength at all!However, the golden needle pricking acupoints requires the support of superb internal strength.

Jun Wuyi's eyes lit up, and he heard the strong self-confidence in his words. He smiled and said, "Mo Xie, you only have a third-grade profound energy cultivation. Even if you are not much better than an ordinary person, you can withstand my grasp! Even the color on your face does not change. Such endurance is not that of an ordinary second-generation ancestor."

Although the grasp just now was unintentional and did not use all his strength, how could the grasp of the Earth Xuan master be something that ordinary people could bear?I'm afraid that even a master of Jin Xuan would frown at this, but Jun Xie, a lowly person who obviously only had third-grade profound energy, actually endured it without even using his own low level of profound energy to resist!

Jun Wuyi knew full well how much pain he had to endure, and he endured the scratch without any defense, but his face did not change color!This character...

What a pity!Looking at Jun Xie, Jun Wuxin sighed in his heart. Unfortunately, Jun Xie was already too old at this time. No matter how hard he endured, it would be hopeless to practice high-end profound energy in this life. Otherwise, judging from his perseverance, there might really be a powerful master in the Jun family!

We are still three short of being on the new book list on the home page. Fengling doesn't have high requirements, but she just hopes that Xie Jun can be on the new book list today!I hope that brothers will raise their hands to help and cast a vote, so that our evil king can take another step forward.Please, brothers!Everyone is enthusiastic, even if it is just one vote, Feng Ling feels so warm!Please...thank you>
